verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Trilegal advises clients on AI law (a dedicated AI practice page and a Gen AI regulation whitepaper) and offers a DPDPA Compliance Assessment Tool, but nothing describes how the firm itself uses AI in client service. There are no named AI tools, no internal AI-use policy and no AI product of its own. Advisory work about AI is an adjacent capability, not disclosure of the firm's own AI use, and the DPDPA tool is not described as AI-based.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the firm publishes how it uses AI in client service — named tools, policies, or AI-practice products of its own — beyond a marketing mention
